basic_info.description: This is a beautiful and very light and sunny top floor condo in Noe Valley. 3 bedrooms each with custom built in closets and 1 large bathroom with sun roof that opens! The hardwood floors in the house have been refinished as well as the entire interior freshly painted. The living room has custom wood windows, wood burning fireplace, and custom built in cabinetry. In unit laundry, tons of storage, 2 car parking and a shared yard. The location is A+, close proximity to all tech shuttles, Sanchez slow streets, 24th St in Noe, Valencia St and freeway access. Must see condo!
